items.text: Consent from both, plus birth certificate

en.focal: Carry the child's birth certificate either way
en.alt: Decision tree showing which document to carry depending on who is not travelling: a consent letter for the other parent, a custody or court order for an ex with no contact, a death certificate copy for a parent who has died, or consent from both plus a birth certificate when both parents are not travelling, with a note to carry the child's birth certificate either way
en.caption: Four situations, four documents, and one birth certificate that helps in all of them. This is our read of what airlines and border officers most often ask for, not a legal checklist. Requirements vary by destination and by carrier, so check your destination's immigration authority and your airline before you travel.
